# tebib_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key to install on new VMs. VMs copy the key when they are created: deleting or replacing the key later doesn't change them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_ssh_key" "me" {
  name       = "me"
  public_key = file(pathexpand("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub"))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's SSH keys. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format (ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA of at least 3072 bits), e.g. `file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")`. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) SSH key ID (`key-...`).
- `key_type` (String) Key type, e.g. `ssh-ed25519`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_ssh_key.me key-abc123
```
